samples.xml_description:
<module id="right_shifter">
    <description>Initialize the q register to 0 and on each rising edge of the clock, shift the contents of the q register to the right by one bit and insert the new input bit d into the most significant position of the register.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">Clock.</input>
        <input id="d">Input.</input>
        <output id="q" width_description="[7:0]">Output.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <enum id="state_0" value="0">State 0.</enum>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="sequential_logic">
        <reg id="q" type="reg" width="8">8-bit register q.</reg>
        <reg id="state" type="reg" width="1">State register.</reg>
        <always>
            <case>
                <when test="state == <state_0>">
                    <assign>q = 8'b00000000;</assign>
                    <assign>state = <state_0>;</assign>
                </when>
            </case>
        </always>
    </logic_description>
    <implementation>Initialize the q register to 0 and on each rising edge of the clock, shift the contents of the q register to the right by one bit and insert the new input bit d into the most significant position of the register.</implementation>
</module>
